title: ウイニングチケット登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket—a deeply emotional Umamusume—dreams of entering the Japanese Derby and becoming a racer who inspires others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She trains with Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide, and together they cultivate a friendly rivalry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket's journey to enter the Japanese Derby begins!
